examples.title: Example 1: Implementing a ScrollBar Component with Child Components
examples.description: This example illustrates the style of a ScrollBar component with child components.

examples.title: Example 2: Implementing a ScrollBar Component Without Child Components
examples.description: This example illustrates the style of a ScrollBar component without child components. The scrollBarColor attribute is added since API version 20.

examples.title: Example 3: Enabling Nested Scrolling
examples.description: This example demonstrates how to enable nested scrolling for a ScrollBar component using the enableNestedScroll attribute. This feature is available from API version 20.
